assign.card: remote MCP: live_post writes cards to /live

decision.question: review size
decision.why: small diff (one tool, one test, docs); top-priority ask, Sonnet fresh-eyes review is enough

findings.text: `RemoteMCP.js:~113` live_post reuses the `page_add` handler from `page_tools()` (same line shape, `ts` and `by: "voice-app"` set, path fixed in `LIVE_PATH`, no path input), which is what requirements.md asked for; no second JSONL writer.

The test in `RemoteMCP.test.mjs` points `live_path` at a throwaway page, so it never touches the real `public/live/page.jsonl`. It does not exercise the real `/live/` path. That is acceptable, but the live default (`LIVE_PATH`) is only checked by reading.

The diff is code only. Whether a Servex restart is needed (yes, the tunnel endpoint loads `RemoteMCP.js` at boot) and the Claude app step (reconnect the connector or start a new conversation so `tools/list` is re-fetched) must go in the card and message to mastermind-voice-20261015. Neither is in the diff.
`mcp-unify.md` is linked from `Servex/ext/remote/readme.md` and `Servex/readme.md`, and it is marked as not built, with the ~70-tool first cut. It matches the ask.
Missing-title calls return a JSON-RPC error (`-32602`) rather than a tool error. The voice model may handle that worse than a text result, but it works.

answer.reply: noted: real /live/ is the default, covered by the first live run after restart
noted: restart and app step go in the card and the message
noted: kept as a JSON-RPC error
